$comment: Human-verified false positives for the PII gate (scripts/audit-pii.mjs).
Add entries SPARINGLY and ALWAYS with a written reason. Never weaken the
detection pattern to make a finding go away — that is how a real number
eventually ships. If you are tempted to allowlist something that looks
like a real personal number, the correct action is to remove the number.
Matching is on digits only, after separators are stripped.

allow.reason: Synthetic test fixture in packages/contract/test/contract.test.ts. Proves MemberDTO strips injected phone/contact/contactNo keys (implementation_plan.md §12.1 control 3). The value is deliberately '017' followed by eight zeros — no real subscriber number takes that form, so allowlisting it cannot mask genuine PII.
